text: The Titanic might have survived if it had hit the iceberg head-on.
Instead, the crew turned. The iceberg scraped along the side, opening five compartments. One more than the ship could take.
Head-on, the bow would have crumpled, flooding maybe two. The ship was built to survive four.
In eighteen seventy-nine, a ship called the Arizona did hit an iceberg head-on, and made it to port.
But a head-on crash would still have been deadly for anyone in the bow, and turning away is instinct.
Would you have turned, or hit it? Full video on my channel.
